data.description: Renamed from SAPIA in 2024. Publishes SA liquid fuel demand data, annual reports, and industry statistics. Total domestic consumption is approximately 17.5 billion litres per year; KwaZulu-Natal and the inland market account for 71% of domestic demand.

data.name: Investing.com â€” Brent Crude Spot Price (UKOIL)
data.description: Primary reference for Brent crude spot price in USD/barrel. South African diesel prices are directly driven by the DMPR's Basic Fuel Price (BFP) formula, which uses a 30-day average of Dated Brent crude plus a crack spread.

data.name: ICE â€” Brent Crude Futures
data.description: Brent futures curve for forward price exposure monitoring. Useful for anticipating future DMPR adjustments before the 30-day average crystallises.

data.name: TradingEconomics â€” South Africa Fuel Price Historical Data
data.description: Historical SA fuel price series with Brent crude as a correlated indicator. Useful for trend analysis, seasonality, and forecasting fuel cost movements.
